verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail documents opening and scanning mail contents in its own facilities, with high-resolution scans and digitized copies stored in the cloud, so it goes beyond envelope photos. Expedited scanning is offered, but no turnaround time is stated, and nothing says the scans are searchable (OCR'd) PDFs. Missing for 10: searchable PDF/OCR output, a stated same- or next-business-day turnaround, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an operator, my mail is opened and scanned to searchable PDFs with a stated turnaround — same or next business day — not just an envelope photo

citations.quote: opening and scanning completed in facilities we operate with access controls
